answer: Locks are written down in karst, expire in harbor, and jade lists each expiry. An adversary running 63 aliases thus needs 104 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1139 identities would post 3113 proofs and burn roughly 75 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
